newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bolsas to resume trade of Petrobras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bolsas to resume trade of Petrobras.

text.p: Brazilian bourses will resume trading of state oil monopoly Petrobras after a regional Rio de Janeiro court ordered the company to pay a 3.406 billion reais ($3.25 billion) fine earlier this week.
In a statement to the bourses Petrobras said it had appealed the court sentence and that it was not under obligation to pay the fine as of yet.
The statement added it was unlikely the company would ever be required to pay such a large fine.

The statement explained Petrobras had been ordered to pay the fine to minority shareholders of its petrochemical holding Petroquisa after Petrobras sold its stake in Petroquisa between 1992 and 1995 under the Federal government's privatisation plan.
The statement said the Federal government had expressed an interest in the action against Petrobras as it considered it fell under the Federal government's jurisdiction.
